verifiedAgainst.title: SP-404MK2 Reference Manual — Using the MFX effects
SP-404MK2 Reference Manual — Temporarily output only the effect sound (MUTE BUS)

text.ru: Выбери Reverb в [MFX] ([MFX] + [VALUE]) и играй снейр.
text.en: Pick Reverb in [MFX] ([MFX] + [VALUE]) and play a snare.

text.ru: [SHIFT] + [BUS FX] — MUTE BUS: слышен только эффект, без сухого сигнала.
text.en: [SHIFT] + [BUS FX] — MUTE BUS: only the effect is heard, without the dry signal.

tryIt.ru: Включи MUTE BUS на удар снейра и отпусти — хвост «зависнет» в паузе.
tryIt.en: Turn MUTE BUS on at a snare hit and let go — the tail hangs in the gap.
